flood_ledger_talk.old: Somebody has cut a notch for every flood since before the village had a headman, and built the shelf a hand above the worst of them.
flood_ledger_talk.new: Each notch is a flood, with its year cut underneath. The oldest years run back past the village's first headman, and the shelf clears the highest notch by a hand.

martial_field_loop.old: [Basic Repair] — You cut and lay boards across the stringers until the walk is a walk again. It holds when you lean on it, and it will hold tomorrow.
martial_field_loop.new: [Basic Repair] — You cut boards to the span and lay them across the stringers. The walk takes your weight from one end to the other.

martial_field_loop.old: The dray is empty and the shed is full. Nothing more to shift today.
martial_field_loop.new: The dray stands empty and the shed is stacked to the door. The bank head has no more work in it until tomorrow.

thicket_keeps_skill.old: [Detect Magic] — The shard is one link of a boundary that used to ring the whole thicket. It still pulls, faintly, along the exact line the deer refuse to cross. It was drawn to keep something in, and it has been failing at that for a very long time.
thicket_keeps_skill.new: [Detect Magic] — The shard is one link of a boundary that once ringed the thicket, and the pull in it still runs the exact line the deer refuse to cross. It faces inward, and there is very little of it left.
